model.name: R19.60: Pre-existing rooms backfill files[] from on-disk FileUnits so old rooms restore files on join.
model.description: Rooms created BEFORE the Room.files[] IOR pattern (R19.46) may have FileUnit scenario units on disk (in their room folder) but an empty files[] array. On room load/join, the server MUST backfill files[] by scanning for FileUnit symlinks in the room's canonical directory and adding their IORs to files[]. This one-time backfill ensures old rooms restore their files for joining members without requiring manual re-upload.
model.tronQuote: > PO diagnosis (HeartSpace loss): pre-existing rooms' files[] must be backfilled from on-disk FileUnits so old rooms restore files on join.
model.crossRefNote: R19.46 (Room.files[] IOR list as source of truth) is the target state. R19.14 (file as scenario unit) defines the FileUnit shape. R19.60 bridges old rooms to the new model via one-time backfill.
